events.title: Pilates World Record Attempt, Wellness Festival & Charity Village
events.source: manx radio & allevents (peel) & visitor events calendar
events.description: Pilates World Record Attempt, Wellness Festival & Charity Village Overview: On the 19th of July, Isle of Man to Host World Record Pilates Class in Global Homecoming at Knockaloe. 34Moves, in collaboration with Ramsey Crookall and Visit Isle of Man, plans to establish not only the world record for the largest Pilates class but also to host a global Pilates homecoming to Knockaloe on the Isle of Man. This attempt to break the current world record of 3,486 participants will be led by top instructors from around the world, offering an enjoyable, inclusive, wellness-focused experience for beginners and experts of all ages, backgrounds, and abilities to come together in unity and movement. Pilates & The Isle of Man: People may be unaware that Pilates' origins are closely linked to Knockaloe and the Isle of Man. Knockaloe holds a prominent place in the Island’s history, demonstrating the impact of global conflicts on individuals and ideas. It was home to the world’s largest civilian internment camp during WWI, bringing together extraordinary men with diverse skills, creativity, and resilience through their detention. Among these men was Joseph Pilates, who began developing his physical training system rooted in physical and mental wellness, which eventually became known as Pilates and is now practised by millions worldwide. Knockaloe exemplifies how hardship can lead to innovation, cultural exchange, and a lasting global influence, and how one man’s commitment to health and discipline ignited a movement. World Record Attempt: This world record attempt aims not only to bring together people of all ages but also to showcase the Isle of Man as a destination where nature, wellbeing, and community come together. It is more than just a fitness event; it aims to establish the Isle of Man as a centre for mindful tourism and contemporary movement culture. At 14:00, participants will come together to attempt to break the current world record of 3,486 people in a single Pilates class. The class will: - Be guided by leading Pilates teachers from around the world - Focus on unity, presence, and mindful movement - Celebrate Pilates as it was originally intended — accessible, empowering, and grounded in wellbeing - No prior Pilates experience required! Note: You will be provided a t-shirt for the world record attempt! More details to follow on collection. The t-shirt MUST be worn for the pilates world record attempt! Wellness Festival & Charity Village: Alongside the world record attempt, the venue will host a Wellness Festival & Charity Village that will offer a vibrant range of physical, mental, and emotional well-being activities. The festival will emphasise local producers, businesses, and charities, with stalls showcasing Manx food, drinks, crafts, products, wellness services, and charitable initiatives. The Village aims to promote connection, balance, and sustainable living, while proudly highlighting the Isle of Man’s unique UNESCO Biosphere status. Running throughout the day, the Wellness Festival & Charity Village will showcase a mix of: - Isle of Man food & drink - Celebrate Isle of Man heritage and culture. - Local & international wellness brands and practitioners - Crafts, products, and experiences - Charities and community initiatives - Spaces for rest, connection, and inspiration Please note: Exhibitors, teachers, and the full event line-up will be announced gradually over the coming months, with regular updates shared via email and official event channels. The Event: 10:00 – Wellness festival & charity village opens Morning – Early Afternoon – Wellness activities, movement sessions & festival experiences 14:00 – World record pilates class attempt 14:30 – 17:00 – Festival continues, closing celebrations & community connection 17:00 – Event close Who Is This Event For? - Everyone, local and visitors alike - Pilates practitioners and teachers - Beginners curious about Pilates - Wellness enthusiasts - Anyone drawn to movement, history, and meaningful experiences Annoucements: Upcoming announcements will include: ✔️Festival Exhibitors ✔️ Special guests, celebrities & partners ✔️ International expert instructors showcasing from around the world All will be revealed over the coming months — this page will be updated regularly, and newsletters will be sent out to ticket purchasers. events.title: Lloyd Cole
events.description: Lloyd Cole will take to the road in 2026 with a run of solo shows. His elegant solo live performances in recent years have been predominantly acoustic, but for these concerts he has decided to go electric. The performance will run the gamut from his masterful debut with the Commotions ‘Rattlesnakes’ right up to 2023’s acclaimed ‘On Pain’ touching on all points in between. Says Lloyd: “In 1999, in retreat from mainstream ambivalence, the idea of becoming a troubadour was perversely alluring. Two acoustic guitars, a suitcase, and a round the world ticket. It took a while for me to become comfortable with it, but The Folksinger Show became my staple. And then, somehow or other, twenty-five years were gone, and now I find myself approaching the end of my career, and wanting to be seen more as just a singer, who wrote a body of work, very little of which one would reasonably label ‘folk’. So I’m back with my Telecaster, my Princeton amp, and my solo show is now electric.”

events.description: Lloyd Cole Solo Show Lloyd Cole will take to the road in 2026 with a run of solo shows. His elegant solo live performances in recent years have been predominantly acoustic, but for these concerts he has decided to go electric. The performance will run the gamut from his masterful debut with the Commotions ‘Rattlesnakes’ right up to 2023’s acclaimed ‘On Pain’ touching on all points in between. Says Lloyd: “In 1999, in retreat from mainstream ambivalence, the idea of becoming a troubadour was perversely alluring. Two acoustic guitars, a suitcase, and a round the world ticket. It took a while for me to become comfortable with it, but The Folksinger Show became my staple. And then, somehow or other, twenty-five years were gone, and now I find myself approaching the end of my career, and wanting to be seen more as just a singer, who wrote a body of work, very little of which one would reasonably label ‘folk’. So I’m back with my Telecaster, my Princeton amp, and my solo show is now electric.” You may also like the following events from VillaGaiety:This October, 28th October, 07:30 pm, Michael Starring Ben | Isle of Man in DouglasAlso check out other Music events in Douglas, Concerts in Douglas, Entertainment events in Douglas.

events.title: OMD - Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark
events.description: Orchestral Manoeuvres in the Dark (OMD), the synth-pop duo from Wirral, England, pioneered their genre combining massive chart success with experimentation on albums such as "Organisation"(1980) “Architecture and Morality” (1981) and “Dazzle Ships” (1983). Hits such as “Enola Gay”, “Maid of Orleans”, and ‘Souvenir’ propelled them into the stratosphere and helped shape the musical landscape of the eighties. In 1986 OMD conquered the United States, and yielded the hit, "If You Leave" from the Pretty In Pink Soundtrack... Following the celebration of their 40th anniversary, OMD returned in 2023 with their first new studio album since 2017's highly praised The Punishment Of Luxury, a record entitled Bauhaus Staircase. The record is regarded as OMD's most explicitly political record and the crowning achievement of their desire to be both Stockhausen and Abba - born from the impetus to kickstart new explorations during lockdown when, as Andy McCluskey admits: "I rediscovered the creative power of total boredom." It shows the band to be one of the few of their generation still able to create music that inspires and was received to critical and fan acclaim. In January 2024 they hit the road to play their largest and most successful UK tour to date, culminating in their biggest ever London show at the O2 arena. US touring followed with spectacular performances at LA’s Dark Wave and Cruel World festivals, and sold out consecutive nights at the Greek Theatre Over the past four decades — give or take a decade break —the band have sold over 40 million records worldwide, establishing them as electronic synthesiser pioneers and one of Britain’s best-loved pop groups. OMD's set is full of energy and loaded with their hits, so bring your dancing shoes!

events.description: Countering Financial Crime Conference 2026 A flagship event is being organised this year to strengthen efforts to protect the Isle of Man from the harmful impact of financial crime.About this EventThe Countering Financial Crime Conference 2026, scheduled to take place at the Villa Marina on Wednesday 12th August, will bring together a diverse group of experts, practitioners, and policymakers.Speakers will share their professional insight and highlight best practice aimed at counteracting money laundering, terrorist financing, proliferation financing, and other financial crime.A key highlight for this year will be further discussions around the suite of National Risk Assessments, the upcoming MONEYVAL evaluation and as always some interesting international guests.Each year this event has been a sell out, so get your tickets fast!The conference is being coordinated by the Financial Services Authority in conjunction with Island agencies including the Isle of Man Financial Crime Partnership, the Government’s AML Policy Office, Gambling Supervision Commission, the Financial Intelligence Unit, the Isle of Man Constabulary, Isle of Man Customs and Immigration, the Attorney General’s Chambers and Department for Enterprise. A number of off-Island presenters will provide an international perspective to a range of current and future financial crime challenges.As was the case in 2025, the event is being predominantly funded through the Island’s Seized Asset Fund and will support efforts to maintain the integrity of the Island’s financial services sector through capacity building and the exchange of knowledge. events.title: 2026 Nowthen Threshing Show
events.venue: 7415 Old Viking Blvd Nw, Nowthen, Mn, United States, Minnesota 55330
events.description: 2026 Nowthen Threshing Show Welcome to the 55th Annual Nowthen Threshing Show! This year featuring John Deere tractors and engines. Founded in 1837 by Vermont blacksmith John Deere in Grand Detour, Illinois, the company revolutionized agriculture with the first commercially successful self-scouring steel plow, designed to cut through sticky Midwestern soil. After moving to Moline, IL, in 1848 for better transportation, the company grew, incorporating as Deere & Company in 1868. Key Historical Milestones: 1837: John Deere creates the first steel plow from a broken saw blade, solving the issue of dirt sticking to cast-iron plows. 1848: Operations move to Moline, Illinois, to access water power and rail transportation. 1868: The business is incorporated as Deere & Company. 1918: John Deere enters the tractor business by purchasing the Waterloo Gasoline Engine Company. 1956: The company begins global expansion, opening its first foreign manufacturing plant in Mexico and acquiring a German tractor firm. 1990s-2000s: Introduction of GPS, GreenStar precision technology, and AutoTrac automated steering transforms the company into a leader in digital, data-driven agriculture. Today, Deere & Company is the world's leading manufacturer of agricultural machinery, widely recognized for its green and yellow equipment and the "Nothing runs like a Deere" slogan. We're hoping to showcase many examples of John Deere history at the 2026 Nowthen Threshing Show. We hope to see you there.

events.title: John Bramwell - I am Kloot
events.description: As the singer in I Am Kloot from 1999 to 2014, John Bramwell achieved a Mercury Prize nomination for 2010’s 'The Sky At Night', a Top 10 chart position for 2013’s 'Let It All In', numerous UK and European tours and a triumphant farewell at the Queen Elizabeth Hall with an orchestra in 2014. Now, as a solo artist, Bramwell travels a very different path, a path that criss-crosses the length and breadth of the UK with a humble agenda of taking his heart-warming songs to the stage and enjoying another moment in time with his devoted fans. The stunning 2023 sophomore solo album, 'The Light Fantastic' was an almost complete U-turn from the I Am Kloot outlook they were known for. Darker clouds banished and in replacement strings, four-part harmonies (a warming development, since Kloot never had any backing vocals) and a dozen gloriously exhilarating, beautifully crafted and observed songs about life, humanity, the universe and everything. As John put it, “It’s been great to find the joy of making music once again. These are the most uplifting songs of my career.” The album received unanimous praise from the UK press but it is the all-encapsulating live show where Bramwell conjures up his true magic as songwriter and performer. Bramwell has been on a never-ending rolling adventure since his workings away from Kloot and in the last three years has visited almost every parish in England, Scotland and Wales to be met with halls, theatres, arts centres, churches, festival tents and folk clubs full with his eager fans waiting to see which direction Bramwell will take the mood of the night – the enriched, wildly playful inter-song banter is so good, a stand up comedy tour has been contemplated. Bramwell’s razor sharp wit, on the line and refreshingly true (and often hilarious) observations and instantly recognisable haunting vocal channelled through some of the most honest and direct song writing of our times has seen Bramwell championed in rave reviews, time after time. Most recently, God Is In The TV celebrated John’s 2025 'Beautiful Days' performance as the highlight of the weekend.

events.title: Frank Bruno, MBE "My Life and Times"
events.description: Frank Bruno, MBE "My Life and Times" In association with GRAIN and VINE, Ale and Cocktail House From the tough streets of Hammersmith, London, young Frank Bruno channelled his energy into boxing at just nine years old. A "problem child" who found focus at a special school, he became the youngest-ever Amateur British Champion at 18. Turning pro in 1982, "True Brit" exploded onto the scene with a staggering 21 consecutive knockout wins — 38 of his 40 career victories ended inside the distance, showcasing one of the most fearsome punching powers in heavyweight history. He thrilled millions at sold-out arenas, battling legends like Mike Tyson (twice) and Lennox Lewis. After three heartbreaking world title challenges, Bruno finally lived the dream in 1995, outpointing Oliver McCall at Wembley Stadium to claim the WBC Heavyweight Championship — only the third Briton ever to do so. The roar of the crowd that night still echoes. But Frank's greatest fight came outside the ring. Diagnosed with bipolar disorder, he faced mental health battles with raw honesty and courage. Today, as an MBE and founder of The Frank Bruno Foundation, he champions awareness, using boxing to support others. Big, bold, humorous and unbreakable — Frank Bruno is British boxing royalty with stories of glory, grit and hope that will captivate every guest. Don't miss this unforgettable night with one of the UK's favourite "National Treasures" Hosted by Dave Moore Tickets are priced @ £ 25-00 (with 100 "Early Bird" Tickets @ £ 20-00) and will be available from 10am on Tuesday 21st April from: https://www.villagaiety.com/ Our generous main sponsors for this event are: Grain and Vine, Ale and Cocktail House, 6 Victoria St who will be hosting our VIP "Meet and Greet" with Frank @ 5pm til 630pm on the Sunday afternoon. His double life gave him access to the darkest corners of humanity, uncovering secrets that would save lives - but at the cost of his own safety. Forced into witness protection by an FBI-uncovered assassination plot, his career as a detective came to an abrupt end, leaving him with chilling memories of murderers and the justice system that hunts them. Prepare for an unforgettable evening of true crime as Peter Bleksley reveals the harrowing reality behind solving murders and battling the criminal underworld. This is crime-fighting as you’ve never seen it before. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

events.description: Celebrating 30 years since the release of their breakthrough album Spiders, Space return to the stage on their 2026 UK tour, bringing with them a brand-new studio album, Ten Neurotic Fairytales, released September 2026. events.description: An Evening with Sir Alastair Cook CBE. Hosted by the brilliant Geoff Miller OBE, former England cricketer & selector, who is a highly respected figure on the after dinner circuit!About this EventSir Alastair Nathan Cook CBE is England's leading Test Run scorer of all time and is coming to the Isle of Man as our guest speaker, on Thursday 12th November 2026, at an event sponsored by Standard Bank (Isle of Man).The 41-year-old Gloucester born cricket legend played in 161 test matches and scored 12,472 runs.Universally acknowledged as an opening batsman of immense poise, grit and skill, Sir Alastair made his debut with the Test side in 2006 and became England’s all-time leading run scorer in 2015. He captained the Team from 2012 to 2016, is a three-time Ashes winner and the 5th highest run-scorer in the history of Test Cricket.Cook’s unique talent and flair, combined with outstanding leadership qualities, relentless drive and commitment, have propelled him to the Olympian Heights.There is an interesting musical link to his career success. As a chorister and boarding pupil at St Paul’s Cathedral School, a hectic practice and rehearsal schedule imbibed the young Alastair with what was to become his legendary resilience and self-discipline.The evening will be hosted by the brilliant Geoff Miller OBE, former England cricketer and selector, who is a highly respected figure on the after dinner speaking circuit. Geoff is sure to have our audience in raptures, with a plethora of amusing recollections and in depth analysis of the game he loves. These qualities have seen him twice voted Sporting Speaker of the Year and Cricket Speaker of the Year for the past 4 years.Tickets:Members: £65.00 p/p exc VAT.
